name: @factstack/factspack
description: FactsPack (.pack) wire format encoder + decoder. Pure isomorphic TypeScript implementation of the spec at docs/FACTSPACK.md — vendored pure-JS SHA-256 for the v0.2 integrity trailer (no node:* at runtime; tests parity-check against node:crypto). ~80% token-cost reduction vs JSON on tabular MCP responses (symbols, imports, callers, findings).
